ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels occupy approximately 75% of the visible surface, contrasted against low-intensity (black) pixels (approx. 25%) concentrated at the leading edges, trailing margins, and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous high-intensity white blobs dominate the central lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation frames the perimeter. Discrete, vertical low-intensity linear bands are mapped on the distal white regions of both lobes (rake marks).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central angle of approximately 45 degrees dividing the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Serrated trailing edge with increasing pixel-amplitude toward the lateral tips; high-amplitude, irregular calcified protrusions are visible on the extreme lateral boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density, high-intensity white/grey circular clusters concentrated on the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes, corresponding to barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of parallel, vertical low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) visible on the distal white portions of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle encrustations on the lateral fluke tips, creating irregular structural profiles along the margin.
